descriptions.breast_benign: Benign breast tissue is characterized by well-organized, cohesive glandular and ductal units lined by a preserved bilayer of luminal epithelial and outer myoepithelial cells displaying uniform, bland round-to-oval nuclei with inconspicuous nucleoli, surrounding patent lumens and embedded within dense eosinophilic collagenous or loose fibroadipose stroma lacking infiltrative patterns or cytologic atypia.
descriptions.breast_malignant: Malignant breast tissue features infiltrative cords, irregular nests, and poorly formed tubules of atypical epithelial cells demonstrating high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, marked nuclear pleomorphism, coarse hyperchromatic chromatin, prominent nucleoli, and frequent mitoses invading a dense, desmoplastic collagenous stroma.
descriptions.colon_aca: Invasive, irregularly shaped, and fused atypical glandular structures with cribriform patterns and intraluminal dirty necrosis are lined by pseudostratified, hyperchromatic, pleomorphic columnar epithelial cells displaying high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, prominent nucleoli, and loss of polarity within a desmoplastic, reactive stroma.
descriptions.colon_n: Normal colonic mucosa features regularly spaced, parallel tubular crypts lined by a monolayer of tall columnar enterocytes interspersed with abundant pale, round mucin-filled goblet cells containing basal, uniform, polarized nuclei, all supported by a delicate, cellular lamina propria.
descriptions.lung_aca: Histopathology demonstrates atypical cuboidal to columnar epithelial cells forming irregular acinar glands, papillary structures, or solid sheets embedded within desmoplastic stroma, characterized by enlarged pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei, prominent nucleoli, abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, and occasional intracytoplasmic or luminal mucin pools.
descriptions.lung_n: Delicate, lace-like pulmonary parenchyma characterized by expansive, empty alveolar airspaces bordered by thin alveolar septa lined by attenuated pneumocytes and containing fine capillary loops, with occasional round intra-alveolar macrophages.
descriptions.lung_scc: Cohesive nests and solid sheets of large polygonal epithelial cells characterized by abundant dense eosinophilic cytoplasm, distinct cell borders with intercellular bridges, prominent pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei, and areas of keratin pearl formation within a desmoplastic stroma.
descriptions.oral_normal_oral_cavity: Orderly stratified non-keratinized to parakeratinized squamous epithelium with progressive basal-to-superficial maturation and regular rete ridges rests on a well-vascularized lamina propria of dense collagenous stroma containing minor salivary gland acini, capillaries, and underlying bundles of skeletal muscle.
descriptions.oral_oscc: Infiltrative sheets, irregular nests, and cords of pleomorphic polygonal squamous epithelial cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, distinct intercellular bridges, and hyperchromatic atypical nuclei, featuring concentric eosinophilic keratin pearls and individualized dyskeratosis surrounded by a desmoplastic fibrous stroma.
descriptions.ovarian_clear_cell: Tubulocystic, papillary, or solid arrangements of polygonal epithelial cells exhibiting abundant optically clear cytoplasm, sharply defined cell membranes, and hyperchromatic, pleomorphic nuclei, characteristically displaying bulbous hobnail cells protruding into luminal spaces amidst dense hyalinized stroma.
descriptions.ovarian_endometri: Pseudostratified columnar cells with crowded, elongated hyperchromatic nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm arranged in confluent back-to-back tubular and cribriform glands featuring smooth luminal borders, occasional squamous metaplastic morules, and minimal intervening fibrous stroma.
descriptions.ovarian_mucinous: Ovarian mucinous tissue is characterized by glandular, cystic, or papillary architecture lined by tall columnar epithelium with abundant pale, apical cytoplasmic mucin and basally located, hyperchromatic nuclei, often surrounded by dense fibrous stroma and extracellular mucin pools.
descriptions.ovarian_non_cancerous: Non-cancerous ovarian tissue is characterized by spindle-shaped stromal cells with uniform, bland ovoid nuclei arranged in intersecting fascicles and storiform whorls within a dense, fibrillary collagenous background, occasionally interspersed with quiescent primordial follicles or simple, monolayered cuboidal-to-columnar epithelial inclusion cysts lacking nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, or destructive infiltrative architecture.
descriptions.ovarian_serous: Complex branching papillary, micropapillary, and slit-like glandular architectures lined by stratified, pleomorphic epithelial cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, enlarged vesicular nuclei, prominent macronucleoli, frequent atypical mitotic figures, and scattered concentric laminated calcifications (psammoma bodies) within fibrovascular stroma.

prompt_template: You are a pathologist writing a single, dense sentence that a vision-language model's text encoder will compare against histopathology image patches. Describe the class {class_name!r} (dataset: {dataset}) in ONE sentence, focused on visually distinctive tissue morphology (cell shape, arrangement, texture) -- not clinical significance or diagnosis. Output only the sentence, no preamble, no quotes.
